_meta.description: Synonym groups for case-insensitive compare. Strings in the same group are treated as equal.
_meta.usage: Loaded by 01_tools/excel_compare.py via _get_syn_map(); reverse-lookup dict: lowercased_string → canonical form (first Cyrillic entry, or first entry if no Cyrillic).
_meta.how_to_extend: Add new groups to the 'groups_extra' list in this file, OR add new translations to localization_dictionary.json and re-run scripts/build_synonyms.py.
